thread:
jordan_support: Heads up — onboarding flow for customer 'Clairvoy' hit a provisioning error during SSO step, users can't complete activation. Error: 403 on token exchange.
ops-bot: Incident created INC-2026-2437 (sev=high) — pager sent to oncall.
jordan_support: Saw ~12 affected users, one trial seat at risk for renewal next month. Flagging urgent handback to CS.
raj_csm: @jordan_support thanks — can you paste logs and which env? prod or staging?
jordan_support: prod. snippet:
```
POST /sso/exchange 403 {"error":"invalid_grant","desc":"token expired or revoked"}
service: idp-proxy v2.1.4
```
lee_se: Repro'd locally, looks like our refresh-token TTL mismatch after recent IdP config change.
maria_cs: Ok assigning ownership — @raj_csm you'll own the comms to Clairvoy, @sasha_manager will join for exec updates.
raj_csm: Taking it. Quick plan: 1) immediate customer note acknowledging issue, 2) ETA for fix 2 hours, 3) follow-up postmortem + credits offer. Drafting message now.
sasha_manager: Add renewal risk flag in SFDC/ChurnSignal and schedule a check-in after fix :warning:
raj_csm: Draft note:
```
Hi Clairvoy team — we saw an SSO activation error impacting new user signups. Our engineering team is investigating and we expect a fix within 2 hours. We'll follow up once resolved and provide next steps. — Raj (CS)
```
jordan_support: Patch ready in canary, rolling to prod in 10m. Deploy command:
```
./deploy --service idp-proxy --image=redwood/idp-proxy:v2.1.5-canary
```
maria_cs: Great. I'll send the customer note once you confirm rollout success. Please ping when canary passes @raj_csm.
lee_se: Canary passed at 1768001140, rolling full prod now.
ops-bot: Deploy success: idp-proxy v2.1.5 deployed to prod at 1768001148 :tada:
jordan_support: Confirmed 0 errors in last 5m, backlog of signups processing.
raj_csm: Sent update to Clairvoy, offered expedited onboarding session and one month credit. Asked them to confirm if any users still blocked.
maria_cs: Marking ticket RESOLVED, setting follow-up PM with customer in 3 days. Thanks everyone :heart:
